entries.name: Macupatide / LY3532226
entries.stage: Recruiting Phase 2 combination study; separate Phase 1 study not yet recruiting
entries.mechanism: GIP receptor agonist studied alone and with the amylin agonist eloralintide
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a recruiting Phase 2 study of macupatide and eloralintide, alone or in combination, in an estimated 200 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes. It records an actual 16 October 2025 start and estimated March 2027 primary completion. A separate Japanese Phase 1 study remains not yet recruiting and has only an estimated October 2026 start.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed registry records do not establish UK marketing authorisation for macupatide or the combination.
entries.limitations: Recruitment is not a result. Neither study has posted results, estimated enrolment and completion dates may change, and the Phase 1 study must not be described as started while its registry status remains not yet recruiting.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Research participation does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
